name: A Leatherface / Bubba Sawyer visual novel
source:
A short visual novel about dating Leatherface, inspired by that one Michael Myers dating sim.

In this visual novel you can date Leatherface from Texas Chainsaw Massacre, be careful on what you do to him so you don't end up dead!

[From [url=https://capriciousmoral.itch.io/a-leatherface-bubba-sawyer-visual-novel]Itch.io[/url]]
